title: An app that breaks when sockjs fallback transports are used
description:
Connect Cloud shipped a regression that broke websockets under some conditions. It didn't get caught in regression testing because most applications didn't apparently break; they fell back to xhr streaming and continued to work fine.

However, a customer had a fairly complex application published to the product that _does_ seem to stop working correctly when websockets are unavailable. They reported the regression and we fixed our websockets. But my understanding is that the fallback transports ought to  retain workable functionality in all cases, so I thought I'd report this in case the Shiny team cares to investigate further.

I don't have a minimized reproducer (or any further information about the root cause), but I can provide steps to reproduce and an internal link to the application's source code.

Steps to reproduce:
1. Visit the application in question at https://01995305-2b49-8caf-0d51-9a9e8dfc88b4.share.connect.posit.cloud/ (user may unpublish, if it's gone ping me)
2. Observe that functionality such as choosing a dataset and then switching the graph to "Vertical Bar" works
3. Force fallback to xhr streaming by running this in the browser js console
```
window.localStorage["shiny.whitelist"] = '["xhr-streaming"]';
```
4. Refresh page for localStorage change to apply
5. Note that application somewhat works. The UI loads, you can select an initial dataset, and the default graph is displayed. However, when requesting to change to a "Vertical Bar" chart or some other functionality, it no longer works.

The application was uploaded privately to Connect Cloud, so I obtained permission to access/share internally at Posit for this analysis. [Posit Google Drive link](https://drive.google.com/file/d/10afX22Wis1iicfJnJjyFGjQQx3JwxphO/view?usp=sharing).

title: Add custom data to init method
description:
Hi! I have a shiny server-client application, which is receive/send data from/to server using web sockets. Now I want to emulate connection to an application from another client. To do this I create a page with javascript

```
<script src="/sock/jquery.min.js"></script>
<script src="/sock/shiny.min.js"></script>
<script src="/sock/sockjs-0.3.4.min.js"></script>
<script src="/sock/shiny-server-client.min.js"></script>
<script>preShinyInit({ reconnect: true, disableProtocols: [] });</script>
```

At the first time another client sends data via web socket 

```
["1#0|m|{\"method\":\"init\",\"data\":{\".clientdata_pixelratio\":1,\".clientdata_url_protocol\":\"http:\",\".clientdata_url_hostname\":\"salesbox\",\".clientdata_url_port\":\"\",\".clientdata_url_pathname\":\"/sock/\",\".clientdata_url_search\":\"\",\".clientdata_url_hash_initial\":\"\",\".clientdata_url_hash\":\"\",\".clientdata_singletons\":\"\"}}"]
```

But shiny application send

```
["1#0|m|{\"method\":\"init\",\"data\":{\"optsTabset\":\"Strategy\",\"generate:shiny.action\":0,\"note\":\" \",\"strategy\":\"CapPro\",\"paths\":\"1000\",\"ul\":[],\"start_date:shiny.date\":\"2021-02-16\",\"adjust_mean\":false,\"rhp:shiny.number\":5,\"fix_cpn:shiny.number\":0,\"hist_depth:shiny.number\":5,\".clientdata_output_scenarios_plot_width\":500,\".clientdata_output_scenarios_plot_height\":400,\".clientdata_output_scenarios_plot_bg\":\"rgb(255, 255, 255)\",\".clientdata_output_scenarios_plot_fg\":\"rgb(51, 51, 51)\",\".clientdata_output_scenarios_plot_accent\":\"rgb(51, 122, 183)\",\".clientdata_output_scenarios_plot_font\":{\"families\":[\"Helvetica Neue\",\"Helvetica\",\"Arial\",\"sans-serif\"],\"size\":\"14px\"},\".clientdata_output_strat_params_hidden\":false,\".clientdata_output_downloadData_hidden\":false,\".clientdata_output_scenarios_plot_hidden\":false,\".clientdata_output_scenarios_table_hidden\":false,\".clientdata_output_distrib_table_hidden\":false,\".clientdata_output_generated_hidden\":false,\".clientdata_pixelratio\":1,\".clientdata_url_protocol\":\"http:\",\".clientdata_url_hostname\":\"10.56.154.141\",\".clientdata_url_port\":\"\",\".clientdata_url_pathname\":\"/scenarios/\",\".clientdata_url_search\":\"\",\".clientdata_url_hash_initial\":\"\",\".clientdata_url_hash\":\"\",\".clientdata_singletons\":\"\"}}"] 
```

As you see some init data are apply to init method.

How to add some init data to init method?

Thank you in advance!

title: `fixupInternalLinks` changes bookmarks
description:
I have a custom Shiny app that uses bookmarks in anchor elements (`href="#dest"`) to navigate through the app (I'm using a custom function to render a tabbable UI element with Bootstrap 4). On Shiny Server Pro (1.5.10.990), the links are changed by adding the path of the server to the link (`href="http://servername/#dest"`) effectively breaking the functionality. The culprit seems to be the function `fixupInternalLinks()` in `shiny-server-client.min.js`. Is this expected behavior, or should this function leave bookmarks untouched? The same effect can be seen with a bare-bones app using `navbarPage()` with `tabPanel()`, but in this case the functionality does not break although the internal link is still changed.

*Note:* I only get this behavior on Shiny Server Pro when using another location than `/`.

title: Application-level reconnects broken when network-level reconnects are disabled
description:
If the robust connection is disabled, the application-level reconnects (`shiny$allowReconnect(TRUE)`) is broken. It will throw JS console errors on trying to reference a property off of `undefined`.

The workaround today is just to leave the robust connections enabled if you plan to use Shiny reconnects.
